decisions.reason: Being of the same opinion is an exact sourced adjective suitable for agreement. Do not add the unsupported requirement of active rather than passive support.
Preparation/training, especially athletic body training, directly fits exercise and workouts. Psychological stimulus conditioning and laboratory specimen preparation are not selected.
No exact English factual candidate was extracted. The model's claim that this is a more precise academic behavioral synonym is not sufficient evidence.
The sugar-rich food meaning is self-contained and fits sweets/desserts. No inherent elaborate craftsmanship, high quality or formality is claimed.
Conferring an honor or presenting a gift directly explains the presentation act. It does not require a comparative formality ranking against conferral.
The explicit honor/gift presentation definition resolves the circular conferring/conferment candidate and fits presentation vocabulary.
Something made from many previously separate parts clearly fits composite collections. The source does not require a random or loose arrangement, which is not imported.
A member of congress is the sourced nongendered occupational/title meaning related to congressman. No jurisdiction-specific power or political viewpoint is implied.
Suitable or appropriate together is a clear compatibility meaning. Do not equate it with legal pursuant or geometrically congruent in every context.
The only candidate repeats conjectures without explaining the activity, and the financial-speculator context may differ. Keep this unclear sense correspondence hidden.
Joining, uniting or combining is explicit and fits the general joining context. Preserve transitive grammar; exclude marriage, logical AND, grammatical coordination and archaeological nouns.
The source explicitly explains jointly or together. The earlier legal/formality ranking is not needed and is not promoted.
Secret cooperation in wrongdoing is a clear general-English verb. Reject the misleading concert/music linkage and do not select the rare botanical sense; connections remain unreviewed.
The blood/ancestry relationship is supported, but the Business collateral anchor normally concerns financial security. This specialist kinship homonym connection is not established.
Being painstaking and careful directly matches workplace diligence. Exclude the separate conscience-based moral sense and unsupported equivalence to Fitness mindfulness.
The intended recipient of a shipment is explicitly defined and matches logistics. Do not generalize the word to every type of recipient.
The person delivering or committing merchandise is a sourced logistics role. This need not cross a national border, so the old exporter equivalence is not approved.
The headword appears truncated by loss of the accented ending. No exact factual candidate supports this identity; a separately sourced consommé correction is needed.
No exact plural definition was extracted and the proposed anchors mix component parts with represented voters. Do not choose between them from model text alone.
Accord with an appropriate constitution is explained directly in the source. This is lexical meaning, not a determination that a particular action is legally legitimate.
Restricting scope or freedom of action is the correct sourced adjective for restrictive. The circular noun candidate is a different POS and remains unselected.
An interpretation of meaning is a complete direct match for interpretation. No requirement of subjective psychology or formal register is added.
The candidate only points to construction and does not resolve the intended building-method distinction from architectural. Retain unclear sense/usage detail hidden.
The sole definition repeats consummate without explaining mastery or completeness. The model's perfection gloss is not independent factual evidence.
Transporting cargo in large standard containers is explicitly defined and relevant to packing/logistics. Software containers and modifying ships/industries are separate senses.
The source only says in a contiguous manner. A standalone sourced touching/adjoining explanation is still missing.
Smuggling/duty evasion meanings do not establish the intended ordinary Fitness/TOEIC runner sense. Keep this homonym-based criminal-trade extension hidden.
The supported senses concern legal ownership transfer, not physical portability or shipping. The proposed portable connection remains a sense mismatch.
Moving something from one location to another clearly matches transport/delivery. Property-transfer documents, title transfer and information transmission are not mixed into this selected meaning.

Local WordNet adds physical twisting, rotating and brain-fold meanings but does not resolve the intended complexity sense. Preserve the earlier withholding instead of substituting a mathematical or anatomical meaning.

The sourced process of managing taxing circumstances/stress is the appropriate general-English cope meaning. Explicitly reject the old brick-wall interpretation and retain masonry/bird-care senses hidden.
Polymer chemistry is unrelated to Fitness abs, which refers to abdominal muscles rather than ABS plastic. The factual chemical meaning does not validate this homonym expansion.
Dried coconut meat used for oil extraction is a clear food-material meaning related to coconut. No nutrition benefit, industrial-use-only requirement or dietary advice is added.
The source explicitly explains bodily/physically, appropriate to bodily existence and anatomy. Exclude unrelated Business physical-property uses and no register claim is imported.
Abrasion/erosion is geology, not financial deflation in Business. The old wind-erosion gloss is a topic and homonym mismatch.

Confirmation through documentary evidence is a complete sourced meaning fitting evidence/documentation. It does not independently prove any real-world claim or require every use to involve a separate person.
The adrenal-cortex or synthesized steroid hormone definition is precise anatomy-related terminology for the steroid anchor. Publish lexical meaning only, with no drug use or performance guidance.
The crow/raven bird family does not match the Fitness crow pose context. Taxonomic validity is not sufficient topic relevance.
No exact factual candidate was found and the proposed heraldic shield divisions are unrelated to Business/TOEIC quarterly periods. Keep hidden for both evidence and relevance reasons.
The mechanical device connecting adjacent objects is a self-contained engineering meaning matching connector. Organ keyboards, acoustic modems and wireless energy-transfer senses are excluded.
